evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies peer connection management and compact block relay handling in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Adds an opt-in parameter allowing operators to manually select peers for persistent high-bandwidth BIP152 compact block relay. This provides a clear use case for operators running multi-site nodes or private peering links who need predictable compact block announcements, but automatic dynamic peer selection already functions and the addition is reasonably deferrable.
